title: Tidal Memory
description: A map of sea-surface height anomaly from satellite altimeters. Dark blues mark lower-than-average ocean height; warm colors mark higher height. The sweep turns those visible differences into a low, spacious Dorian landscape: position sets time, height sets pitch, and contrast adds emphasis. A soft root drone keeps the oceanic frame grounded while the playhead reveals local variation.

title: Canopy Lift
description: GEDI laser observations reveal the three-dimensional height of Earth’s forests. Brown and dark green areas are shorter vegetation; bright green and white areas are taller. The jukebox maps this height field into a gentle pentatonic pattern, with bright forest structure lifting the melody. A restrained mallet voice leaves space around the root drone so the canopy feels expansive rather than busy.

title: Atmospheric Drift
description: NASA’s GEOS-CF model tracks carbon monoxide, particulate matter, ozone, and nitrogen oxides as they move through the atmosphere. Here, color represents modeled pollutant concentration and transport. Dense, bright regions create more active notes while the underlying Phrygian scale keeps the mood unsettled but musical. The airy root drone moves slowly with the frame’s mean brightness.

title: Carbon Weather
description: This model view follows carbon dioxide as it moves through Earth’s atmosphere from January to March 2020. Plumes reflect emissions, fires, wind, and uptake by plants and oceans. The sound follows the image’s visible color structure rather than raw ppm values, using a restrained minor palette. A low drone represents the frame-wide atmosphere while sparse notes pick out visible plumes.

title: Afterglow
description: Black Marble imagery compares changes in night lights between 2012 and 2023. Purple regions indicate more light and orange regions indicate less. The sweep turns this human footprint into small, luminous tones: brightness raises loudness, and clusters create a wider pulse. The whole-image drone slowly opens as the global night field becomes brighter.

title: Fireline
description: VIIRS observes active fires and fire radiative power across the globe. Bright hot spots show intense activity while the dark map recedes behind them. This is the urgent closer: warm pixels trigger bright plucks, concentrated columns add density, and a minor scale keeps the mood focused. Its root drone stays conservative so urgency comes from visible clusters, never from excessive volume.
